rows.text: runs four initialisers, each with the object address in `rcx`: a 139-byte one on `02CBBE00`, an 89-byte one on `02CBBF88`, a 102-byte one on `02CBC018` and a 31-byte one on `02CBC368`; then tail-jumps `atexit` with a 12-byte exit stub
calls a 209-byte routine with the incoming `rcx`, a 15-byte callback in `rdx` and dword `01F7F590` in `r8d`, then stores dword `01F7F590` plus 1, ANDed with 3, back to `01F7F590`

advances dword `[rcx + 0xCB8]` to `(value + 1) AND 3`, then for that index walks the 16-byte entries from qword `[rcx + 0xC38 + index * 0x20]` up to qword `[rcx + 0xC40 + index * 0x20]`, calling each entry's first qword with its second qword in `rcx`, and finally stores the `+0xC38` qword over the `+0xC40` qword
tail-jumps to the 167-byte slot reset with qword `01F7F5B8` in `rcx` and dword `[rcx + 0x10]` of the incoming `rcx` in `edx`

when qword `[rcx + 0x28]` is null it zeroes qwords `[rcx]`, `+8` and `+0x10` and dword `+0x18`; otherwise, with `s = [rcx + 0x28]` and `r = [s + 0x50]`, it stores dword `[r + 0x38]` to `+0x10`, qword `[s + 0x60]` to `[rcx]`, dword `[s + 0x74]` to `+0x14`, dword `[r + 0xF8]` to `+0x18` and qword `[s + 0x10]` to `+8`, and when the `+0x14` value is nonzero it then, while `[rcx]` equals `[rcx + 8]`, adds the `+0x10` value to `[rcx]` and replaces `[rcx + 8]` by the qword it points to

gets a key from the 159-byte routine that formats `rdx` through `%s%s%s` and lower-cases it, then searches the tree rooted at qword `[rcx + 0x2218]` with head `rcx + 0x2208`, keeping each node whose dword `+0x20` is at least the key (unsigned) and descending `+8` from it, else descending `+0`; when the kept node is the head or its key is above the key it returns 0, otherwise it tail-jumps a 4-byte getter that returns qword `[[node + 0x28]]`

calls a 648-byte routine with `ecx = 0` and `edx = 6`, then a 19-byte setter that stores its `ecx` argument (the incoming `ecx`) into dword `+0x179D4` of a global object when that object exists, and tail-jumps to a 364-byte routine

clears bit 31 of dword `[rcx + 0x30]` and returns `base + edx * 0x58 + 0x38` (edx zero-extended), where the base is qword `[rcx + 0x38]` when the remaining value is above 1 (unsigned), `rcx + 0x38` when it is 1 and null when it is 0

takes the `0x38`-byte slot `rcx + edx * 0x38` (edx zero-extended): walks its node chain from qword `+0x10` up to the head `slot + 8` through a 68-byte successor helper, calling the first virtual slot of each node's `+0x20` object; then, for each node from qword `+0x18` along the `+8` links, calls a 96-byte recursive helper on `(slot, [node])` and frees the node through virtual slot `+0x18` of `slot + 0x30` with size `0x28`; finally stores `slot + 8` to `+0x10` and `+8`, 0 to qword `+0x18`, byte `+0x20` and dword `+0x28`
